E1.checked: 1 ability (vision). I recomputed SHA-256 of GameplayGate.java 4ddeec26... OK. E1 thresholds normal 0, easy 0, hard 2, chaos 0, custom_vision 5 equal the raw configs. However, no cited site checks vision. GameplayGate.java:10 just adds VISION to CLIENT_DEPENDENT/IMPLEMENTED, and nothing in the plugin calls GameplayGate.allows(..., VISION). The cited family resolver AbilityResolvers.findItemAbility can never return VISION: VISION is item("ender_eye") at AbilityType.java:21, USE_ENDER_EYE is item("ender_eye") at AbilityType.java:143, and the HashMap fill at AbilityResolvers.java:31-34 lets USE_ENDER_EYE overwrite it. The real server contribution is the threshold/unlocked projection to the client (bridge/BridgeWire.java:99), and the effect comes from the client mod's GameRendererMixin. Neither is cited. I recomputed row thresholds from each runtime's raw config (campaign1N/runtime/plugins/AchieveToDo/progression/configs/*.toml) and all of them match. The E1 chaos value comes from campaign16's chaos_20261116.toml (e55204bd...). The chaos rows of this group come from campaign14, whose same-named file has a different hash (5fcf0a51...) and different values. Each row carries its own threshold, so this matches accepted behaviour (b).

findings.description: The E1 source map does not identify any site that checks vision. GameplayGate:10 is only set registration. The cited family resolver findItemAbility('ender_eye') returns USE_ENDER_EYE and never VISION, because the item binding key collides and the later entry overwrites it. The relevant sites are uncited: the bridge threshold/unlock projection (bridge/BridgeWire.java:99) and the client GameRendererMixin.

All modes rows run in NORMAL where vision has threshold 0. creative and spectator test an already-unlocked state and op is NA. The behaviour of a locked vision under creative, spectator or op is never tested, although HARD and custom_vision offered a locked state.
The case notes say 'NORMAL/EASY/HARD threshold 0', but HARD has vision=2 and the campaign13 rows test it as locked. The documentation text is wrong.

The probe reports the tested ability as null ("VISION": null) in every state line, so the server log never shows the lock state of this ability. Locked status follows only from count < threshold, which I confirmed against the raw config, and from the client overlay in rows.jsonl.

The client-mod path is stored with its Cyrillic folder name mojibake-encoded (UTF-8 bytes read as cp1251), so a third party cannot open it as written. I located the real file and its hash matches. This is a record defect only.
